title: Healthcare client: from spreadsheet to verified dashboard
context: Condensed from many Codex sessions. The briefs are paraphrased; the steps, findings and numbers come from the repo's commits and docs. Client, account and campaign identifiers removed.

messages.name: Brief
messages.text: Replace the client's spreadsheet with a daily dashboard. Start with discovery; no implementation until decisions are made.

compact.label: Brief
compact.title: Discovery first
compact.summary: Replace the client's spreadsheet with a daily dashboard. Start with discovery; no implementation until decisions are made.

messages.name: BigQuery · Sheets · Git
messages.text: Read schemas, aggregates and logs. Nothing was changed.

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: The sources are sufficient, but there are 9 gaps and 8 decisions that are yours.

contentBlocks.title: Decisions for you
contentBlocks.text: Domain, Woo → Shopify migration boundary, revenue definition, country rule (shipping or billing), access.

tooltip.title: A document first
tooltip.body: The agent says what was checked and what wasn't, and stops for decisions.

messages.name: Brief
messages.text: Net and total revenue; Shopify from 29 April 2026, Woo before; paid, non-test orders only; refunds on the order date; Google login allowlist.

compact.label: Brief
compact.title: Decisions
compact.summary: Net and total revenue; Shopify from 29 April 2026, Woo before; paid, non-test orders only; refunds on the order date; Google login allowlist.

messages.name: Cloud Run · Shopify API
messages.text: The Shopify pipeline is deployed and verified.

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: The dashboard is live, but Ads by country is deliberately hidden.

compact.title: Hidden on purpose
compact.summary: On a sample day ~2/3 of spend (PMax) has no country in the shared export.

contentBlocks.text: Check for one day: Performance Max is about 67% of account spend, and GeoStats has not a single PMax row. Neither summing both location types nor using presence alone reproduces the spreadsheet.

contentBlocks.title: No guessing
contentBlocks.text: The country view shows as unavailable until it reconciles with total account spend.

messages.name: Brief
messages.text: Use the Google Ads MCP for physical user location, including PMax. Reconcile every campaign for every day.

compact.label: Brief
compact.title: New source
compact.summary: Use the Google Ads MCP for physical user location, including PMax. Reconcile every campaign for every day.

messages.name: System
messages.text: Read-only, fixed account, pinned version. A result with 50,000 rows (the cap) is rejected, not treated as complete.

tooltip.title: A connector with boundaries
tooltip.body: Here MCP is a source under contract: scope, row cap, provenance and the export's SHA-256.

messages.name: Google Ads MCP → BigQuery
messages.text: 365-day backfill, reconciled by campaign and day.

compact.label: Backfill
compact.title: 365 days, every campaign/day
items: 2 unnamed geo IDs: kept, not guessed

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: Unexpected: the shared mart is ~0.44% below the API. Names aren't the cause.

compact.title: Cost mismatch
compact.summary: 291 days outside tolerance. Same campaign, same day, two different costs in raw.
items: The bug is in the shared export
MCP takes precedence on verified days

thinking.title: What it checked
thinking.summary: The gap was traced to the raw tables, before naming and currency conversion.
items: Compared MCP, CampaignBasicStats and CampaignStats for one ID and one date.
Ruled out renames and EUR conversion as the cause.
The reference pipeline is not touched. The issue is logged for a separate fix.
The DTS copy keeps running in parallel for comparison and fallback.

tooltip.title: A finding from reconciliation
tooltip.body: The bug was in a tool every client uses. We found it because the second project reconciled the numbers.

messages.name: Cloud Scheduler · Cloud Run
messages.text: The MCP job is in production.

compact.label: Production
compact.title: ads-mcp-sync
compact.summary: 07:25 and 13:25, the last 31 days every run.
